about: The alleluia of the formulary “Mass of the Easter Vigil” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.nr: The celebrant intones Alleluia three times, each time at a higher pitch, and all repeat each intonation in the same tone.

seg.tr: Give praise to the Lord, for He is good, for His mercy endures forever.

ex.w005: The adjective is the predicate of an understood subject, the Lord, with the verb left out: “for [He is] good”.

seg.tr: Praise the Lord, all nations, and praise Him together, all peoples. For His mercy toward us has been made firm, and the truth of the Lord remains forever.

a.g: His mercy toward us has been made firm

ex.w021: Confirmata est describes mercy as made firm. Super nos points to us as its recipients.
